name: Rexnord Electronics and Controls Limited
about: Rexnord Electronics and Controls Limited manufactures and sells instrument cooling fans and motors for industrial purposes in India. It provides AC axial fans and motors, EC fans and motors, BLDC and shaded pole motors, DC brushless fans, duct fans, mounting stands, aluminum impellers, metal and plastic impellors, and metal and plastic finger guards. The company also exports its products. Rexnord Electronics and Controls Limited was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
